title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: Decent (though uneven) tape of a solid Tidewater show featuring an uptempo "Eyes of the World" and a nice "The Other One", with psychedelic moments despite some sloppiness.
ai_review.review: Fans note that the performance is mixed—some parts feel lazy, yet there are intense, psychedelic stretches and standout renditions of "Eyes of the World" and "The Other One." The recording itself required EQ to sound good and suffers from uneven balance, but it’s still listenable for those interested in this rare Tidewater-era set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives generally positive remarks (4‑star) with standout songs, while the recording is described as uneven and needing EQ (lower rating). Weighted average yields ~3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention difficulty achieving an even sound; EQ improves it, indicating some muddiness or imbalance in the original tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical three‑set structure with a psychedelic undertone throughout; some moments feel lazy, but high points keep the momentum.
